verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly document table-level and connection-level re-sync ("Re-sync | YES | Connection level and table level. A parent table re-sync includes all associated child tables") plus History Mode for backfilling historical data, and community evidence confirms Fivetran performed a full re-sync without extra pipeline rebuild work. This directly matches the story of resyncing/backfilling a single table without rebuilding the whole pipeline. missing for 10: no first-party doc detailing the exact UI/API workflow for a single-table backfill across all connector types, and no independent hands-on confirmation of table-level (vs only connection-level) resync in practice.
